name: Jules
tagline: Async coding agent that clones your repo and ships PRs.
description: Jules is Google's asynchronous coding agent. It clones your GitHub repository into a secure Google Cloud VM, understands the full project context, then writes tests, fixes bugs, and makes multi-file changes in the background before opening a pull request. A Jules Tools CLI and a Jules API extend it into your own workflows.
insight: First revealed as a Google Labs project in December 2024, Jules reached general availability on August 6, 2025.

modelSupport.notes: Runs on Gemini 3 Pro for Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers.

changelog.summary: Model updated from Gemini 2.5 Pro to Gemini 3 Pro for Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers.

edge: Async agent that works in a cloud VM and hands back a PR — complete with an audio changelog of what it changed.
pros: Fully async, runs in the background
Jules Tools CLI + API to extend it
cons: Async loop slower than in-editor agents
